findings.text: Acceptance 1/5: uploader ownership bypasses current conversation access. In-memory route reproduction: remove the uploader from a private channel; GET conversation returns 403, but GET file returns 200 with 1146 fixture bytes and GET file/info returns 200. Require canRead for conversation attachments, including their uploader; retain owner-only access for files without a conversation.

Acceptance 1/11 (GC5): an instance admin outside a private conversation can retrieve its topic through updateConversation. Route reproduction: authenticated non-member admin gets 403 from GET /api/conversations/1, but PATCH /api/conversations/1 with {} returns 200 containing topic PRIVATE_TOPIC_FIXTURE. Check canRead before returning conversation content, or return a content-free acknowledgement for administrative operations without membership.

Acceptance 14: a delayed send inserts its reply into whichever thread is currently open. Deferred-response DOM reproduction: send in thread 90, switch to 91, then complete the POST; output is current root 91, reply roots [null,90], and the isolation assertion fails. Capture the conversation and thread before awaiting; update the panel only if both still match, with a regression test for switching or closing threads during sends.
